usefulness.rationale: Understanding (2): A reader comes away knowing who Xavier Huillard is — born 1954, École Polytechnique and École des ponts ParisTech graduate, at Vinci since March 1998, CEO since 2006, chairman since 2010, previously chairman and CEO of Sogea, then deputy general manager / chairman of Vinci Construction / chairman of Vinci Energies, plus an institutional role at Institut de l'Entreprise. That covers identity and career arc, but the dossier says almost nothing about what he actually did or achieved at VINCI, and the picture of his current role is muddled by multiple stale PDG/CEO claims. RemainingQuestions (1): The dossier flags some items as 'claimed' or 'contested' (education, prior role, Vinci prior roles), which is a partial signal of uncertainty, but it never states what it does not know, never notes that the PDG/CEO role ended with the May 2025 split, and presents several stale claims without qualification. ConversationReadiness (1): A reader would have a usable career timeline and education background, but the single most important fact for a meeting — his current title — is wrong in most of the dossier (PDG/current CEO rather than Chairman only, with Pierre Anjolras as CEO since 1 May 2025). Preparing from this dossier would lead to mis-titling him.
